title: CRUST1.0: the Earth's crust on a 1-degree grid, its water, ice, three layers of sediment and three of crystalline crust down to the Moho, with their P and S velocities and densities
provider: G. Laske, G. Masters, Z. Ma and M. Pasyanos, Institute of Geophysics and Planetary Physics, University of California, San Diego
format: A tar.gz of four text files of 64,800 lines (1-degree cells from 89.5 N, 179.5 W, longitude the inner loop), nine values a line for the nine layers (water, ice, upper, middle and lower sediments, upper, middle and lower crystalline crust, and the mantle below the Moho): crust1.bnds, the top of each layer (km above sea level, negative below); crust1.vp and crust1.vs, velocities (km/s); crust1.rho, density (g/cm3).
coverage: Global, 1-degree cells, averaged over each cell
licence: No licence is stated; the model's page asks that it be cited (https://igppweb.ucsd.edu/~gabi/crust1.html). Fetched into the cache, not redistributed.
citation: Laske, G., Masters, G., Ma, Z. and Pasyanos, M. (2013), Update on CRUST1.0: a 1-degree global model of Earth's crust, Geophys. Res. Abstracts 15, EGU2013-2658.
